channel.title: BISCS India Guides
channel.description: Practical guides for free online tools: PDF, GST, images, AI photo editing, video, office, design and SEO.

item.title: Answer Engine Optimisation: Win Snippets and Voice Answers
item.description: Answer engine optimisation (AEO) means structuring answers so search engines, voice assistants and AI tools can quote them directly, for example in featured snippets, People Also Ask boxes and spoken replies. BISCS India’s free AEO Answer Optimizer scores your answer for its question type, previews the snippet and voice version, and generates HTML and JSON-LD.

item.title: Calculate Exact Age from Date of Birth in Years, Months, Days
item.description: To calculate exact age, count the completed years since the date of birth, then the completed months after the last birthday, then the remaining days. BISCS India's free Age Calculator does this for any “age as on” date, and also shows total days, weeks and a countdown to your next birthday.

item.title: How to Blur or Change a Photo Background With AI (Free)
item.description: To blur or change a photo background, open an AI background changer, choose a photo of a person, then pick Blur for a portrait-camera effect or Colour, Gradient or Image to replace it, and download. BISCS India’s AI Background Blur & Changer finds the person automatically and processes everything on your device.

item.title: Remove Background From a Photo Free (Transparent PNG)
item.description: To remove a photo background, open an AI background remover, choose your image, let the model find the person or click the object to keep, touch up edges, and download a transparent PNG. BISCS India’s AI Background Remover runs the AI model on your own device, so your photos are never uploaded.

item.title: AI Crawler Checker: Is GPTBot or ClaudeBot Blocked on Your Site?
item.description: To check whether AI crawlers can access your site, test your robots.txt rules against each AI bot’s user-agent token. BISCS India’s free AI Crawler Access Checker parses a pasted robots.txt using the official rules, shows which of about twenty AI and search bots are allowed or blocked for any path, explains why, and generates new rules.

item.title: How to Blur Faces in a Photo Automatically for Privacy
item.description: To blur faces in a photo, open an AI face blur tool, let it detect the faces, switch off any you want to keep, choose blur, pixelate, a solid bar or an emoji, add any missed faces by hand and download. BISCS India’s AI Face Blur runs the face detector on your device, so the photo is never uploaded.

item.title: AI Image Upscaler: Enlarge Photos 2× or 4× Without Blur
item.description: To upscale an image, open an AI upscaler, choose 2× or 4×, run it and compare the result with the original before downloading. BISCS India’s AI Image Upscaler uses a super-resolution model that runs on your device, so small photos, logos and screenshots get sharper enlargements without being uploaded anywhere.

item.title: Make a Passport Photo With White Background Using AI
item.description: To make a passport photo with AI, upload a front-facing photo, let the tool detect your face and crop it to 35×45 mm, switch on background replacement for plain white, check the guidance list and download the photo or a print sheet. BISCS India’s AI Passport Photo does all of this on your device without uploading anything.

item.title: How to Enhance Photo Quality Online: Fix Dull, Dark Photos
item.description: To enhance a photo, open a photo enhancer, let the Auto preset fix light, colour, noise and sharpness, compare before and after, fine-tune the sliders and download. BISCS India’s Photo Enhancer works instantly in your browser, includes an Old photo preset for faded scans, and offers an optional AI 2× upscale.

item.title: Online Voice Recorder: Record, Trim and Save as MP3
item.description: To record audio online, open a browser voice recorder, allow microphone access, press Record and then Stop. BISCS India's Audio Recorder & Converter shows a live waveform, lets you pause, trim the recording and export it as MP3, M4A or WAV, and can convert existing audio files too. Recordings stay on your device.

item.title: How to Get Genuine Backlinks and Business Listings in India
item.description: Genuine backlinks come from being listed where customers actually look and from earning mentions on relevant websites, not from buying links. BISCS India’s free Backlink & Listing Helper gives you a progress checklist of legitimate listings in India, from Google Business Profile to industry directories, plus editable outreach email templates for resource, broken-link, guest-post and partner requests.

item.title: How to Make a Barcode: EAN-13, Code 128, UPC and More
item.description: To make a barcode, choose a format that suits your use, such as Code 128 for internal labels or EAN-13 for retail products, enter the number or text, and download the image. BISCS India’s free Barcode Generator creates barcodes in your browser as PNG or SVG. For retail products, the number itself must be licensed from GS1.

item.title: Base64 Encode and Decode Online: What It Is and When to Use It
item.description: Base64 converts any data, including images or Unicode text, into a string of 64 safe ASCII characters so it can travel through systems built for text. It is encoding, not encryption: anyone can decode it. BISCS India's Base64 tool encodes and decodes text or files, with URL-safe mode, entirely in your browser.

item.title: How to Split a Restaurant Bill and Tip Fairly Between Friends
item.description: To split a bill, add the tip and any extra charges to the bill amount, then divide the total by the number of people. A ₹2,450 bill with a 10% tip is ₹2,695, or ₹673.75 each for four people. BISCS India’s free Tip & Bill Splitter does this instantly and can round shares for easy UPI payments.

item.title: BMI Calculator Guide: Formula, Categories and Indian Cut-offs
item.description: BMI (Body Mass Index) is your weight in kilograms divided by your height in metres squared. Under WHO categories, 18.5–24.9 is a healthy range, but guidelines commonly used in India treat 23 and above as overweight for Asian Indian adults. BMI is a screening estimate only; BISCS India’s BMI Calculator shows both scales.

item.title: CSS Box Shadow Generator: Soft, Layered and Inset Shadows
item.description: The CSS box-shadow property draws a shadow around an element using up to five parts: horizontal offset, vertical offset, blur, spread and colour, plus an optional inset keyword. BISCS India's Box Shadow Generator lets you adjust each value with sliders, stack up to eight layers and copy the finished CSS, all in your browser.

item.title: CAGR Calculator: Compound Annual Growth Rate Made Simple
item.description: CAGR is the steady yearly growth rate that turns a starting value into an ending value: CAGR = (final ÷ initial)^(1 ÷ years) − 1. An investment that grows from ₹1 lakh to ₹2.5 lakh in 5 years has a CAGR of about 20.11%. BISCS India's free CAGR Calculator finds the rate or projects a future value from one.

item.title: How Many Calories Do I Need a Day? BMR and TDEE Explained
item.description: Your daily calorie need is roughly your BMR (energy used at rest) multiplied by an activity factor, giving your TDEE or maintenance calories. BISCS India’s Calorie Calculator uses the Mifflin–St Jeor equation to estimate both, plus targets for gradual weight loss or gain. Treat the result as an estimate and consult a doctor or dietitian.

item.title: Case Converter: Change Text to UPPER, lower or Title Case
item.description: To change the case of text, paste it into a case converter and click the style you want, such as UPPER CASE, lower case, Title Case or Sentence case. BISCS India’s Case Converter also handles camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case line by line, with undo, and runs entirely in your browser.

item.title: How to Minify CSS, HTML and JSON Online (and What It Saves)
item.description: Minifying code removes whitespace, line breaks and comments that browsers do not need, making CSS, HTML and JSON files smaller and slightly faster to download. BISCS India's CSS / HTML / JSON Minifier does this in your browser, keeps licence comments and preformatted content intact, and shows exactly how many bytes you saved.

item.title: Flip a Coin or Roll Dice Online: Fair Tosses and Real Odds
item.description: An online coin flip or dice roll picks a result at random so each side has an equal chance: 50% for heads or tails, and one in six for each face of a die. BISCS India’s free Coin Flip & Dice Roller uses your browser’s secure randomness, animates each toss, and keeps a running history and tally.

item.title: How to Make a Photo Collage Online Free (No Upload, No Watermark)
item.description: To make a photo collage, choose 2 to 9 photos, pick a grid layout or freestyle arrangement, adjust spacing, borders and background, then download one combined image. BISCS India’s free Collage Maker does this in your browser with ready layouts, story and A4 sizes, captions and high-resolution JPG or PNG export, without uploading your photos.

item.title: HEX to RGB and HSL Colour Converter (With Contrast Check)
item.description: To convert a colour, enter it in any format, such as #4F46E5, rgb(79, 70, 229) or hsl(243, 75%, 59%), and read the equivalents in the others. BISCS India's Color Converter handles HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV and CMYK, shows tints and shades, and checks WCAG text contrast, all inside your browser.

item.title: Compound Interest Calculator: Formula, Frequency and Examples
item.description: Compound interest is calculated as A = P × (1 + r ÷ n)^(n × t), where n is how often interest is added each year. ₹1 lakh at 8% for 10 years grows to about ₹2.16 lakh with yearly compounding and ₹2.21 lakh with quarterly compounding. BISCS India's free Compound Interest calculator also handles monthly contributions.

item.title: How to Reduce PDF File Size for Email and Upload Portals
item.description: To reduce a PDF’s file size, open a PDF compressor, choose a compression level and download the smaller file. Lossless compression keeps text perfect but saves less; image-based compression shrinks scanned PDFs much more. BISCS India’s Compress PDF offers both and works in your browser, so files are never uploaded.

item.title: How to Crop PDF Pages and Trim Margins Online for Free
item.description: To crop a PDF, open a PDF cropper, drag the box on the page preview or type the margins to trim in millimetres, choose whether to apply it to all pages or only the current one, and download. BISCS India’s Crop PDF does this in your browser without uploading. Cropping hides content outside the box rather than deleting it.

item.title: CSS Gradient Generator: Linear, Radial and Conic Made Easy
item.description: A CSS gradient is a smooth blend between colours created entirely in code with linear-gradient, radial-gradient or conic-gradient, so no image file is needed. BISCS India's CSS Gradient Generator lets you choose the type, angle and up to five colour stops visually, then copy ready-to-use CSS with a fallback colour.

item.title: How to Convert CSV to JSON Online (Quotes, Types, Headers)
item.description: To convert CSV to JSON, paste the CSV into a converter that reads the first row as headers and turns each following row into a JSON object. BISCS India's CSV to JSON tool auto-detects the delimiter, handles quoted commas and line breaks, optionally converts numbers and booleans, and runs fully in your browser.

item.title: How to Add or Subtract Days From a Date (With Business Days)
item.description: To add days to a date, count forward that many calendar days; for months or years, move the month or year and keep the same day where possible. BISCS India’s free Add or Subtract Days calculator does this instantly, handles month-end dates, and can count business days that skip Saturdays and Sundays.

item.title: How to Count Days Between Two Dates (Including Working Days)
item.description: To count days between two dates, subtract the start date from the end date in calendar days, and add one if both the first and last day should count. BISCS India’s free Date Difference calculator does this instantly and also shows weeks, months, Monday-to-Friday working days and weekend days.

item.title: Discount Calculator: Final Price After Stacked Discounts
item.description: To find a sale price, multiply the original price by (1 − discount ÷ 100). Two discounts apply one after the other, so 20% plus an extra 10% on ₹2,999 gives ₹2,159.28, an effective 28% off rather than 30%. BISCS India's free Discount Calculator shows the final price, total savings and effective discount instantly.

item.title: EMI Calculator: Formula, Examples and Amortisation Explained
item.description: EMI is calculated as P × r × (1 + r)^n ÷ ((1 + r)^n − 1), where P is the loan, r the monthly interest rate and n the number of months. A ₹25 lakh home loan at 8.5% for 20 years costs about ₹21,696 a month. BISCS India's free EMI Calculator also shows total interest and a yearly amortisation table.

item.title: Entity SEO: Organization and Author Schema With sameAs
item.description: Entity SEO means helping search engines and AI systems recognise your business and authors as distinct, real entities, using consistent details and structured data. BISCS India’s free Entity & Author Schema Builder creates linked Organization, WebSite and Person JSON-LD with sameAs profiles, stable @id references and expertise fields, in your browser.

item.title: Convert Excel to CSV or JSON (and Back) in Your Browser
item.description: To convert Excel to CSV, open the .xlsx file in a converter, pick the sheet and download it as CSV. BISCS India’s Excel & CSV Converter also turns CSV or JSON into Excel, lets you view, search and sort large sheets, and handles delimiters and Indian-language text, all on your device without uploading the file.

item.title: How to Extract Pages from a PDF and Save Them as a New File
item.description: To extract pages from a PDF, open a page extractor, click the pages you want or type them as ranges such as 1-3, 8, then download them as a new PDF. You can also save each page as a separate file. BISCS India’s Extract PDF Pages tool does this in your browser without uploading the file.

item.title: Fancy Text Generator: Stylish Fonts for Instagram and WhatsApp
item.description: A fancy text generator converts ordinary letters into look-alike Unicode characters, such as bold, script or bubble letters, that you can copy into apps that do not offer fonts. BISCS India’s Fancy Text Generator shows 25 styles at once; click any style to copy it for your Instagram bio, WhatsApp status or post.

item.title: FAQ Schema Generator: Build an FAQ Section With FAQPage JSON-LD
item.description: An FAQ schema generator turns your questions and answers into an HTML FAQ section plus matching FAQPage JSON-LD structured data. BISCS India’s free FAQ Schema Generator builds both from one list, so they always agree, previews the section, imports pasted Q&A text and runs in your browser. Google now shows FAQ rich results only for limited sites.

item.title: Favicon Generator: Create favicon.ico and App Icons Free
item.description: To create a favicon, upload a square logo or type a letter or emoji, adjust background, corners and padding, then download the pack. BISCS India’s Favicon Generator produces favicon.ico, PNG icons from 16 to 512 pixels, an Apple touch icon, a web manifest and the HTML to paste, all in your browser.

item.title: FD Calculator: Fixed Deposit Maturity and Interest Explained
item.description: FD maturity is worked out as P × (1 + r ÷ n)^(n × t), where n is the number of compounding periods a year. ₹1 lakh at 7% for 5 years, compounded quarterly as most Indian banks do, matures to about ₹1,41,478. BISCS India's free FD Calculator shows maturity, interest earned and effective yield for any tenure.

item.title: How to Fill a PDF Form Online for Free and Flatten It
item.description: To fill a PDF form, open a form filler, type into the text fields, tick checkboxes, choose radio and dropdown options, optionally flatten the form so values become permanent, and download. BISCS India’s Fill PDF Form works in your browser without uploading. Forms without interactive fields can be filled with the PDF editor instead.

item.title: Find and Replace Text Online, With Optional Regex Support
item.description: To find and replace text online, paste your text, type the word to find and its replacement, preview the highlighted matches and click Replace all. BISCS India’s Find and Replace tool adds match case, whole-word and regular expression options with capture groups, plus undo, all running in your browser.

item.title: What Is GEO? How to Write Content AI Answer Engines Cite
item.description: Generative engine optimisation (GEO) is the practice of making content easy for AI systems such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews to understand, trust and cite in their answers. BISCS India’s free GEO Content Analyzer scores an article on fifteen research-informed checks, from direct answers to sources and statistics, and lists the top fixes.

item.title: Gratuity Calculator: The 15/26 Formula, Eligibility and Tax
item.description: For employees covered by the Payment of Gratuity Act, gratuity = 15 × last drawn monthly basic plus DA × years of service ÷ 26, with a final part-year of six months or more counted as a full year. ₹60,000 a month for 10 years 7 months gives about ₹3.81 lakh. BISCS India's free Gratuity Calculator also shows the tax-exempt part.

item.title: How to Convert a Colour PDF to Black and White (Grayscale)
item.description: To convert a PDF to black and white, open a grayscale converter, choose a resolution such as 150 DPI and an image quality, then convert and download. BISCS India’s Grayscale PDF previews pages in grey before you start and runs in your browser, so your document is never uploaded. Text becomes non-selectable.

item.title: How to Calculate GST: Add or Remove GST with CGST/SGST Split
item.description: To add GST, multiply the net price by the rate and add the result: ₹10,000 at 18% becomes ₹11,800. To remove GST from an inclusive price, divide by (1 + rate ÷ 100): ₹11,800 ÷ 1.18 = ₹10,000. BISCS India's free GST Calculator does both and shows the CGST/SGST or IGST split.

item.title: GST Return Due Dates: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, CMP-08 and Annual Returns
item.description: Monthly GST filers file GSTR-1 by the 11th and GSTR-3B by the 20th of the following month. QRMP filers file quarterly GSTR-1 by the 13th and GSTR-3B by the 22nd or 24th, depending on their state. BISCS India's free GST Due Date Calendar builds your yearly schedule and exports it as calendar reminders.

item.title: How to Check a GSTIN: Format, Checksum and State Code Explained
item.description: A valid GSTIN has 15 characters: a two-digit state code, the holder's 10-character PAN, an entity number, the letter Z and a check character calculated from the first 14. BISCS India's free GSTIN Validator checks all of this in your browser, singly or in bulk, but only the GST portal can confirm a registration is active.

item.title: MD5 and SHA-256 Hash Generator: Verify Files and Text
item.description: A hash generator turns text or a file into a fixed-length fingerprint, such as a 64-character SHA-256 value, that changes completely if even one byte changes. Use it to verify downloads or compare files. BISCS India's Hash Generator computes MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512, plus HMACs, on your device without uploading anything.

item.title: HRA Exemption Calculator: How Tax-Free HRA Is Worked Out
item.description: Your HRA exemption is the lowest of three amounts: the HRA you actually receive, rent paid minus 10% of basic salary plus DA, and 50% of basic plus DA in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata or Chennai (40% elsewhere). BISCS India's free HRA Exemption Calculator shows all three and the taxable balance. It applies only under the old tax regime.

item.title: Hreflang Tags Explained: Set Up Hindi, Bengali and English Pages
item.description: Hreflang tags tell search engines which language or regional version of a page to show each user, such as English, Hindi or Bengali. BISCS India’s free Hreflang Tag Generator creates the head link tags and matching XML sitemap entries for every version, adds an x-default fallback and checks codes, URLs and duplicates in your browser.

item.title: How to Find the HSN or SAC Code for Your Product or Service
item.description: HSN codes classify goods and SAC codes classify services for GST. Search by product or service name, narrow to the right chapter and heading, then confirm the full code and current rate in the official CBIC schedule. BISCS India's free HSN & SAC Code Finder searches HS chapters, common headings and SAC codes offline.

item.title: HTML Entities: How to Escape and Unescape Special Characters
item.description: HTML escaping replaces characters with special meaning in HTML, mainly <, >, & and quotes, with entities such as < and & so browsers show them as text instead of treating them as code. BISCS India's HTML Entity Encoder escapes and unescapes text in named, decimal or hex style, entirely in your browser.

item.title: How to Pick a Colour From an Image and Get Its HEX Code
item.description: To pick a colour from an image, open an image colour picker, upload the picture, click the exact spot you want and copy the HEX, RGB or HSL code. BISCS India’s Image Color Picker adds a magnifier for precise picking and extracts a palette of up to ten dominant colours, all inside your browser.

item.title: How to Compress an Image to a Target Size in KB (Free)
item.description: To compress an image to a specific size, open an image compressor, choose Target size, enter the limit in KB and download. BISCS India’s Compress Image tool finds the highest quality that fits, shrinks dimensions only if necessary, and works in your browser so your photos are never uploaded.

item.title: Convert Images Between JPG, PNG and WebP Online for Free
item.description: To convert an image, choose a converter, add your file, pick the target format (JPG, PNG or WebP), set the quality and download. BISCS India’s Convert Image tool does this inside your browser, converts many images at once and fills transparent areas with a colour you choose when saving as JPG.

item.title: How to Crop an Image Online to Any Aspect Ratio, Free
item.description: To crop an image, open a photo cropper, choose a free or fixed aspect ratio, drag the frame over the part you want to keep and download. BISCS India’s Crop Image tool offers presets from 1:1 to 16:9 and passport 35:45, exact pixel inputs, and runs entirely in your browser.

item.title: Free Online Photo Filters: Brightness, Contrast and B&W
item.description: To edit a photo with filters, open an online photo editor, pick a preset such as Vivid, Vintage or B&W, fine-tune brightness, contrast and saturation with sliders, then download. BISCS India’s Photo Filters tool does this in your browser with nine presets and nine adjustments, and your photo is never uploaded.

item.title: How to Resize an Image in Pixels or Percentage, Free Online
item.description: To resize an image, open an image resizer, enter the new width or height in pixels (or a percentage), keep the aspect ratio locked and download the result. BISCS India’s Resize Image tool does this in your browser, handles many photos at once and never uploads your files to a server.

item.title: How to Convert an Image to Base64 (Data URL, CSS and HTML)
item.description: To convert an image to Base64, open an encoder, choose the image and copy the result as a data URL, raw Base64, CSS background, HTML img tag, Markdown or JSON. BISCS India’s Image to Base64 tool does this in your browser, shows how much larger the encoded text is, and never uploads the file.

item.title: Extract Text From an Image (OCR) in English, Hindi, Bengali
item.description: To extract text from an image, open an OCR tool, add the photo, screenshot or scanned PDF, tick the languages it contains, press Extract text and copy or download the result. BISCS India’s Image to Text tool reads English, Hindi and Bengali, cleans up the image automatically and runs entirely in your browser.

item.title: How to Add a Text Watermark to Photos Online for Free
item.description: To watermark a photo, open a watermark tool, type your text, choose font, colour, size and opacity, place it in a corner or tile it across the image, and download. BISCS India’s Watermark Image tool does this in your browser at full resolution, so your original photos are never uploaded.

item.title: Income Tax Calculator FY 2025-26: New vs Old Regime Compared
item.description: For FY 2025-26, the new regime taxes income above ₹4 lakh in slabs from 5% to 30%, gives salaried people a ₹75,000 standard deduction and a Section 87A rebate that makes tax nil up to ₹12 lakh of taxable income. BISCS India's free Income Tax Calculator compares this with the old regime and your deductions side by side.

item.title: Inflation Calculator: Future Cost and Value of Money in India
item.description: Inflation raises prices at a compound rate, so future cost = today's cost × (1 + inflation)^years. At 6% a year, something costing ₹1 lakh today will cost about ₹1.79 lakh in 10 years, and ₹1 lakh received then is worth about ₹55,800 in today's money. BISCS India's free Inflation Calculator works out both directions.

item.title: How to Create a GST Invoice: CGST, SGST, IGST and Format
item.description: A GST tax invoice lists the supplier and buyer details, GSTINs, a unique invoice number and date, place of supply, HSN or SAC codes, taxable value and tax. Charge CGST plus SGST when supplier and place of supply are in the same state, and IGST when they differ. BISCS India’s free GST Invoice Generator applies this split automatically and saves the invoice as PDF.

item.title: How to Convert JPG, PNG and Photos to a Single PDF (Free)
item.description: To convert images to PDF, open an image-to-PDF converter, add your JPG, PNG or WebP files, arrange them in order, choose the page size and margins, and download a single PDF. BISCS India’s Images to PDF embeds JPG and PNG without re-compressing them and works in your browser, so photos are never uploaded.

item.title: How to Format and Validate JSON Online (With Error Lines)
item.description: To format JSON, paste it into a JSON formatter, choose an indent (2 spaces, 4 spaces or tab) and copy the pretty-printed result. If the JSON is invalid, a good formatter shows the exact line and column of the error. BISCS India's JSON Formatter does all of this in your browser, so API responses never leave your device.

item.title: How to Convert JSON to CSV for Excel (Nested Data Too)
item.description: To convert JSON to CSV, paste a JSON array of objects into a converter, which turns each object into a row and each key into a column. BISCS India's JSON to CSV tool also flattens nested objects into columns like address.city and adds a UTF-8 BOM so Excel shows Indian-language text correctly, all inside your browser.

item.title: How to Decode a JWT Token (and Why Decoding Isn’t Verifying)
item.description: To decode a JWT, split it at the two dots and Base64url-decode the first two parts: the header and the payload, both JSON. Decoding needs no key, which is why it never proves a token is genuine. BISCS India's JWT Decoder shows the claims, expiry in IST and algorithm, on your device without sending the token anywhere.

item.title: Keyword Density Checker: What Is a Healthy Percentage?
item.description: Keyword density is the number of times a word or phrase appears divided by the total word count, shown as a percentage. BISCS India’s free Keyword Density Checker lists the most-used single words and two- or three-word phrases in your text or HTML, measures a focus keyword and flags stuffing, all inside your browser.

item.title: What Is llms.txt and How to Create One for Your Website
item.description: llms.txt is a proposed Markdown file, placed at the root of a website, that gives AI assistants a short summary of the site and links to its most useful pages. It is an emerging, voluntary proposal rather than an official standard. BISCS India’s free llms.txt Generator builds and validates llms.txt and llms-full.txt in your browser.

item.title: How to Make a Simple Logo Free and Download SVG or PNG
item.description: To make a simple logo, type your brand name, choose an icon or initials, pick a font, layout and colour palette, and export it. BISCS India’s free Logo Maker does this in your browser, suggests ideas for your name, previews the logo on light, dark and business card backgrounds, and downloads SVG, transparent PNG and a 512 px app icon.

item.title: Lorem Ipsum Generator: Free Placeholder Text for Designs
item.description: A lorem ipsum generator creates meaningless Latin-style placeholder text so you can fill a design before the real content is ready. BISCS India’s Lorem Ipsum Generator makes any number of paragraphs, sentences or words, can wrap them in HTML paragraph tags, and lets you copy or download the result instantly.

item.title: Lumpsum Calculator: Project a One-Time Investment's Growth
item.description: A lumpsum calculator applies compound growth to a single investment: future value = amount × (1 + return)^years. ₹1 lakh at 12% a year for 10 years grows to about ₹3.11 lakh. BISCS India's free Lumpsum Calculator also shows what that amount is worth in today's money after inflation, with a year-by-year growth table.

item.title: Markdown Preview: Write Markdown and See It Live, Then Export
item.description: To preview Markdown, type or paste it into a Markdown editor and the formatted result appears beside it as you write. BISCS India’s Markdown Preview supports GitHub-flavoured Markdown including tables and task lists, and lets you copy the HTML, export a styled HTML page or download a .md file, all in your browser.

item.title: How to Make a Meme Online With Top and Bottom Text (Free)
item.description: To make a meme, open a meme generator, choose a picture or a blank canvas, type the top and bottom captions, adjust font, size and outline, drag the text where you want it and download. BISCS India’s Meme Generator does this in your browser without adding any watermark to your image.

item.title: How to Merge PDF Files Online for Free (Without Uploading)
item.description: To merge PDF files, open a PDF merger, add two or more files, drag them into the order you want and download the combined PDF. BISCS India’s Merge PDF tool does this in your browser, so documents like bank statements and ID proofs are never uploaded to a server.

item.title: Meta Tag Generator: Write Title, Description and OG Tags
item.description: A meta tag generator turns your page title, description, URL and share image into ready-to-paste HTML for the head of your page. BISCS India's free Meta Tag Generator builds the title, meta description, robots, canonical, Open Graph and X (Twitter) tags in your browser and warns you about lengths and common errors.

item.title: Device Mockup Generator: Screenshots in Phone and Laptop Frames
